turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: How's the API documentation been for integration?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: It's solid overall, well organized. But the websocket streaming docs are thinner than the REST docs — we had to read the SDK source code to figure out reconnection behavior.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: An end-to-end tutorial for a real-time conversational agent, not just isolated endpoint docs, would've saved us a week of trial and error.
